tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One Norwegian legal entity from Brønnøysundregistrene, cleaned: status (active, bankrupt, winding up, deleted), form, industry (NACE), address, employees, VAT registration. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search Norwegian legal entities by name, municipality, industry code, legal form and status. Sole proprietorships are left out of name searches (they are named after people). Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: get_company_tenders
tools.description: Public tenders where this organisation is the buyer, linked by organisation number. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: get_company_awards
tools.description: Public contracts this organisation has won, from Norwegian contract award notices on TED and Doffin (last 180 days): buyer, value, award date and the other winners. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Norwegian public procurement notices from Doffin and TED, filterable by CPV code, region (county or NUTS), deadline and buyer. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: One procurement notice with buyer (linked to the company register), CPV codes, regions, deadline and source link. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: search_addresses
tools.description: Search Norwegian street and cadastral addresses from Kartverket by text, municipality or postcode: coordinates, postcode, municipality, cadastre numbers (gnr/bnr/fnr/snr) and number of units. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: addresses_near
tools.description: Norwegian addresses from Kartverket within a radius (1 to 1000 m) of a coordinate, nearest first, with distance in metres. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: search_laws
tools.description: Search current Norwegian laws and central regulations from Lovdata by words in the title or in the section text, optionally by type and ministry. Title matches rank first; each result carries up to three matching section snippets, not the full text. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base).

tools.name: get_law
tools.description: Metadata for one current law or central regulation from Lovdata (title, short title, date, ministry, last change, link to lovdata.no) and its table of contents: section ids, chapters and headings. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: get_law_section
tools.description: The full text of one section (§ or artikkel) of a current Norwegian law or regulation, with the ids of the previous and next section. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: Official Norges Bank exchange rates against the Norwegian krone: the latest business day, one day (a weekend or holiday gives the prior business day) or a daily series up to 366 days, for chosen currencies or all of them. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: get_finnish_company
tools.description: One Finnish company from the PRH trade register (YTJ), cleaned: status (active, bankrupt, winding up, ceased), company form, industry (TOL 2008), address, website, other names, EU ID. Costs 0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

tools.name: search_finnish_companies
tools.description: Search Finnish companies from the PRH trade register by name (current and former names), town or city, company form, industry code (TOL 2008) and postcode. Give at least one filter. Up to 100 hits per page. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.
